class.name: GameplaySubsystem
class.brief_description: A scoped gameplay service managed by [GameplaySubsystemRegistry].
class.description: GameplaySubsystem provides deterministic initialization and deinitialization for services whose lifetime belongs to an application, world, local player, or connection scope. Subclass it and implement [method _initialize] and [method _deinitialize].

method.name: _deinitialize
method.description: Called once during registry shutdown, in reverse registration order.

method.name: _initialize
method.description: Called once during registry initialization, in registration order.

method.name: get_registry
method.description: Returns the managing registry, or [code]null[/code] before registration or after removal.

members.member: The required lifetime scope. It must match the registry scope.
A non-empty ID unique within the registry.
